title: The starting categories are mapped to the AccountingHub accounts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure AccountingHub is enabled for the organization and the test location has no QuickBooks Online connection.
  • Make sure no one has changed the starting category rows on Account Mappings.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Internal: General Internal" shows 6500 Vehicle Expenses.
  • "No Charge: Warranty" and "No Charge: Goodwill" both show 6430 Warranty & Goodwill Expense.
  • "No Charge: Comeback" shows 6440 Comeback Expense.
  • 6400 Shop Equipment Maintenance is not a category row.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11762 (Story 5, QuickBooks Online account mapping), story SV-11763 (Story 6, AccountingHub account mapping)

  • S6-R2: “Automatically set up the starting category mappings using AccountingHub's existing chart of accounts. General Internal defaults to 6500 Vehicle Expenses, already in the default chart. Warranty and Goodwill both default to 6430 Warranty & Goodwill Expense, already in the newer chart. Comeback defaults to 6440 Comeback Expense, a new required account (number confirmed by the AccountingHub owner on 2026-11-09). The existing 6400 Shop Equipment Maintenance account remains available for accountants to select where appropriate; it is not an additional starting category. The mapping key should allow a kind (parts, labor) later, so V2 adds rows instead of changing the contract.”
  • Feature Overview: “Accounting is one expense account per category. In QuickBooks the accountant maps each category once per location, on the category itself or on the ShopView Accounts page, where the categories show as one row each under Cost of Parts; an empty row posts to ShopView Review as every unmapped row does today, with no fallback to another row. In AccountingHub, Account Mappings holds one row per category, automatically mapped for the starting categories (General Internal to 6500 Vehicle Expenses; Warranty and Goodwill to the existing 6430 Warranty & Goodwill Expense; Comeback to 6440 Comeback Expense). The rollout migration and new-customer setup reuse suitable accounts, create missing required accounts, preserve valid existing mappings and resolve number conflicts with an available number, so all starting mappings are ready before the first job posts (S6-R2); a category the shop adds gets an empty row that holds the event until it is mapped; an archived category keeps its row. The shop supplies credit is unchanged (Story 10). At Close of a whole internal or no-charge work order the parts cost debits the category's account and the credit stays on today's inventory account by part category and stock location. On a billable work order with a no-charge line, that line's parts cost posts to the category's account when the invoice is created; the rest of the work order posts as today.”
